title: Clean-in-place skid
goal: A process engineer can trace chemical supply and return pumping with conductivity, temperature, and diverter instrumentation.

rubric.must: A visible path runs from the CIP tanks through P-501 and DV-501 to ProcessCircuit.
A visible path runs from ProcessReturn through DV-502 and P-502 to TK-503.
XV-501 and XV-502 are visibly in the caustic and rinse tank paths before P-501.
AT-501 and AIC-501 are visibly connected by an electric signal line.
TT-501 and TIC-501 are visibly connected by an electric signal line.
DV-501 and DV-502 visibly show solenoid actuation and FC fail positions.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the pid exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: All required process paths, isolation valves, instrument loops, and fail-closed solenoid actuators are clearly visible and traceable.

items.evidence: Visible process lines run from TK-501/TK-502 through the merged suction, P-501, and DV-501 to ProcessCircuit.
Visible process line runs from ProcessReturn through DV-502 and P-502 to TK-503.
XV-501 is visibly installed between TK-501 and P-501; XV-502 is visibly installed between TK-502 and P-501.
AT-501 and AIC-501 are visibly connected by a dashed electric signal line.
TT-501 and TIC-501 are visibly connected by a dashed electric signal line.
DV-501 and DV-502 each visibly have an actuator box marked S and an adjacent FC fail-position label.
